        return [[2 if a != bg_top and b != bg_bottom else 0 for a,b in zip(ra,rb)] for ra,rb in zip(top,bottom)]
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    bg_left = max(set(v for row in left for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in left for x in row))
    bg_right = max(set(v for row in right for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in right for x in row))
    return [[2 if a != bg_left and b != bg_right else 0 for a,b in zip(ra,rb)] for ra,rb in zip(left,right)]
